uutiset.t: South Africa to Seek Relief From EU’s Proposed Hybrid-Car Curbs
uutiset.s: South Africa will seek an exemption or a country-specific quota if the European Union imposes safeguard measures on hybrid-vehicle imports.

uutiset.t: UBS Holder Cevian Sells Quarter of Stake Amid Capital Debate
uutiset.s: One of UBS Group AG’s major shareholders has sold over a quarter of its stake in the Swiss bank in recent months, coinciding with a period when the outlook for upcoming capital regulations worsened.

uutiset.t: Traders Cash In on Pricing Gaps in Anthropic’s Pre-IPO Contracts
uutiset.s: The frenzy surrounding Anthropic’s upcoming stock market debut has been playing out in digital-asset markets for months, with speculators betting on the artificial intelligence company’s value before its shares begin trading.

uutiset.t: Anthropic Is Said to Guide IPO Price to Top of Range or Above
uutiset.s: Anthropic PBC is guiding prospective investors in its initial public offering it expects to price the shares at the high end of the price range or above, according to people familiar with the matter.

uutiset.t: Trump Arrives in Asia Ahead of Summit with Xi, Putin
uutiset.s: US President Donald Trump kicked off a three-day trip to Asia on Tuesday, meeting regional leaders and saying he’s open to a one-on-one meeting with Russian President Vladimir Putin later in the week. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: México enfrenta trabas para atraer centros de datos de IA
uutiset.s: México tiene ubicación, talento y cercanía con EE.UU. para convertirse en un polo de centros de datos. Pero una red eléctrica insuficiente y la burocracia amenazan con dejarlo atrás. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.s: A surge in Ukrainian attacks on oil-processing plants forced producers to divert crude to exports

uutiset.s: Anthropic se prepara para una de las mayores OPI de la historia, con una valoración que podría llegar a US$1,4 billones. Esto es lo que debe saber sobre su salida a bolsa. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Foreign Investors Pour Record $9.6 Billion Into Indian Stocks in November
uutiset.s: Foreigners are turning into buyers of Indian stocks at a record pace, signaling a broader portfolio shift as the weakening artificial intelligence trade revives demand for a market investors had largely abandoned over the past two years.

uutiset.s: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis President Alberto Musalem signaled support for multiple interest rate-increases in the coming months. uutiset.t: ETF, CEF, Swap, Perp: Investors Get Slice of Anthropic Before IPO
uutiset.s: Anthropic PBC’s much-anticipated Nasdaq debut isn’t expected until later this week, but retail traders are already finding ways to get a piece of the AI giant.

uutiset.t: Nasdaq 100 Futures Rise as Investors Prepare for Nvidia Results
uutiset.s: Technology stocks climbed before the bell on Tuesday as investors prepared for an all-important earnings release from Nvidia Corp. and as a selloff in the artificial intelligence trade eased.

uutiset.t: Amazon, Google to Have About 28% of Anthropic Stock After IPO
uutiset.s: Two of Anthropic PBC’s biggest customers will have more than 28% of its stock in aggregate after it goes public, adding to the close links between the companies powering the artificial intelligence boom.

uutiset.t: Home Depot Names McPhail CEO With Decker Back as Chairman
uutiset.s: Home Depot Inc. said Richard McPhail will take over as chief executive officer from Ted Decker, who is returning from medical leave to serve as chairman.
